appraisal_events.evidence: Il la tenait par l'épaule, l'appuyant contre lui pour la maintenir; puis il lui dit: ne me répondez que par signes... Cela ne vous gêne pas que je remette droites les fleurs de votre corsage... je voudrais les enfoncer un peu.
appraisal_events.explanation: After Odette is frightened by the carriage jolt, Swann calmly takes physical and verbal control, holding her against him and engineering a tender pretext to touch her. He moves into the initiating, protective position while she is left dependent and silenced ('ne me répondez que par signes'), but the passage stops short of narrating the intimacy itself.

status_effects.explanation: Swann gains leverage and initiative in the scene, steering the encounter toward closeness through calm reassurance and a deliberate pretext, though the passage ends just before any consummated intimacy is shown.
